method: Built-in image_gen, followed by deterministic crop, resize and 1bpp conversion
footprint_adaptations: AI-generated contact-stamp designs; not official assets
prompt: Create a production sprite atlas of eleven distinct Pokémon-style footprint icons. Pure BLACK marks on pure WHITE background. Exact square canvas, strict evenly spaced 3 columns by 4 rows, each cell identical size, no grid lines, no labels or text. Each icon centered in its cell with generous margin. Retro Game Boy Advance FireRed Pokedex footprint style: extremely simple chunky low resolution pixel art, each icon conceptually fits a 16x16 grid with most marks within 10x12 pixels, hard square pixel edges, no antialiasing, NO gradients, no grey, no outlines around white background. These are flat ground contact stamps, NOT creature silhouettes or faces. Order row major: row1 col1 Mime Sr: single broad rounded clown-shoe sole with heel; row1 col2 Osscythe: single narrow three-toed skeletal reptile foot, three sharp claws and tapered heel; row1 col3 Omato: tiny four-pronged claw contact print, hollow center. Row2 col1 Omatops: small pointed pivot impression with two short curved scythe scratches to either side, sparse; row2 col2 Deep Magikarp: small pointed diamond fin contact stamp with short central trailing line, sparse; row2 col3 Deep Feebas: tiny narrow two-lobed fin impression with short trailing line, sparse. Row3 col1 Kabustar: three short tapered tentacle-tip contact marks arranged as triangular group, no large solid body; row3 col2 Kabuknight: one long narrow rounded sole with two short rounded toe tips, simple; row3 col3 Amunyte: three small oval tentacle-tip impressions arranged in a shallow fan, sparse. Row4 col1 Kinkabuto: small insect contact print comprising two pairs of sharp little claw impressions, no central body; row4 col2 Aeropteryx: broad three-toed pterosaur foot with hooked toe tips and narrow rear toe; row4 col3 leave completely empty white. Consistent scale and minimal pixel footprint style throughout.
